summary: Password spraying against 35 VPN accounts from a single external address; no successes.
resolution: Source blocked at perimeter after tier-2 approval; MFA coverage confirmed.

summary: Internal red team credential test triggered the brute-force rule.
resolution: Matched approved test ticket; closed as authorised.

summary: EDR quarantined a fake invoice executable delivered by email before execution.
resolution: Hash searched fleet-wide, no other hits; related email purged.

summary: Excel spawned hidden encoded PowerShell that attempted a download.
resolution: Host isolated with tier-2 approval; triage package collected; reimaged after evidence export.

summary: Encoded PowerShell from a documented patch deployment script.
resolution: Change ticket matched; rule tuning request filed.

summary: Automated scanner sent shell metacharacters in the search parameter; WAF blocked all requests.
resolution: No child processes observed; closed as attempted attack.

summary: Large outbound transfer to backup provider after storage migration.
resolution: Asset owner confirmed scheduled migration job; closed as benign.

summary: Impossible travel for a sales user; user confirmed travel with a personal VPN.
resolution: User confirmed activity; advised on approved VPN usage.

summary: Periodic outbound connections from the repository server to an unfamiliar address.
resolution: Traced to an unapproved monitoring agent installed by a contractor; removed.

summary: Long random subdomains traced to a CDN health-check tool.
resolution: Domain added to resolver allow list.

summary: Tabletop exercise scenario: unauthorised Domain Admins membership change (training record).
Payroll-themed credential phishing reached 22 mailboxes; 2 users entered credentials.
resolution: Messages purged, sessions revoked for the two users, sender domain blocked.
